API.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="creating-a-management-key" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#creating-a-management-key">Creating a Management Key</a></h2></span><p>To use the Collections API, you need to create a Management API Key with the <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">AddFileToCollection</code></span> permission. This permission is required for uploading documents to collections.</p><ol>
<li>Navigate to the <strong>Management Keys</strong> section in the <a href="https://console.x.ai/team/default/settings/management-keys?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=developers-files-collections-api&amp;utm_content=management-keys" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">xAI Console</a></li>
<li>Click on <strong>Create Management Key</strong></li>
<li>Select the <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">AddFileToCollection</code></span> permission along with any other permissions you need</li>
<li>If you need to perform operations other than uploading documents (such as creating, updating, or deleting collections), enable the corresponding permissions in the <strong>Collections Endpoint</strong> group</li>
<li>Copy and securely store your Management API Key</li>
</ol><figure class="flex max-h-[540px] w-full items-center justify-center"><img data-original-src="/assets/docs/console/collections/create-management-key-light.png" data-original-width="1028"
